title: NIM Memories
description: Browse the 200 most recently updated memories. Click a memory_id to load linked artifacts and annotations; click an artifact_id to view content and narrow annotations. Select All artifacts to return to all annotations for the memory. Dropdowns list up to 500 recent entities. Entity browsing is independent of the dashboard time range. Detail tables are limited to 500 artifacts and 1000 annotations.

list.name: memory
list.label: Memory
list.query:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (
    SELECT 'All memories' AS __text, 'all' AS __value, 0 AS priority, NULL::timestamptz AS updated_at
    UNION ALL
    SELECT type || ' · ' || id::text, id::text, 1, updated_at
    FROM memories
) options
ORDER BY priority, updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 501
list.definition:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (
    SELECT 'All memories' AS __text, 'all' AS __value, 0 AS priority, NULL::timestamptz AS updated_at
    UNION ALL
    SELECT type || ' · ' || id::text, id::text, 1, updated_at
    FROM memories
) options
ORDER BY priority, updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 501

list.name: artifact
list.label: Artifact
list.query:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (
    SELECT 'All artifacts' AS __text, 'all' AS __value, 0 AS priority, NULL::timestamptz AS updated_at
    UNION ALL
    SELECT a.name || ' · ' || a.id::text, a.id::text, 1, a.updated_at
    FROM memories_artifacts ma
    JOIN artifacts a ON a.id = ma.artifact_id
    WHERE ma.memory_id::text = ${memory:sqlstring}
) options
ORDER BY priority, updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 501

panels.title: Memories — click memory_id to drill down

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    m.id::text AS memory_id,
    m.type,
    m.salience,
    m.strength,
    m.confidence,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memories_recalls mr WHERE mr.memory_id = m.id) AS recalls,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memories_artifacts ma WHERE ma.memory_id = m.id) AS artifacts,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM annotations an WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM memories_artifacts ma
        WHERE ma.memory_id = m.id AND ma.artifact_id = an.artifact_id
    )) AS annotations,
    m.created_at,
    m.updated_at
FROM memories m
WHERE (${memory:sqlstring} = 'all' OR m.id::text = ${memory:sqlstring})
ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT
    m.id::text AS memory_id,
    m.type,
    m.sources::text AS sources,
    m.contexts::text AS contexts,
    m.version,
    m.salience,
    m.strength,
    m.confidence,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memories_recalls mr WHERE mr.memory_id = m.id) AS recalls,
    (SELECT MAX(mr.created_at) FROM memories_recalls mr WHERE mr.memory_id = m.id) AS recalled_at,
    m.created_at,
    m.updated_at
FROM memories m
WHERE m.id::text = ${memory:sqlstring}

panels.title: Linked artifacts — click artifact_id to drill down

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    a.id::text AS artifact_id,
    a.type,
    a.name,
    a.summary,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM annotations an WHERE an.artifact_id = a.id) AS annotations,
    a.created_at,
    a.updated_at
FROM memories_artifacts ma
JOIN artifacts a ON a.id = ma.artifact_id
WHERE ma.memory_id::text = ${memory:sqlstring}
  AND (${artifact:sqlstring} = 'all' OR a.id::text = ${artifact:sqlstring})
ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT
    a.id::text AS artifact_id,
    a.name,
    a.type,
    a.summary,
    a.content::text AS content
FROM artifacts a
JOIN memories_artifacts ma ON ma.artifact_id = a.id
WHERE ma.memory_id::text = ${memory:sqlstring}
  AND a.id::text = ${artifact:sqlstring}

SELECT
    an.id::text AS annotation_id,
    a.id::text AS artifact_id,
    a.name AS artifact_name,
    an.label,
    an.text,
    an.confidence,
    an.spans::text AS spans,
    an.created_at,
    an.updated_at
FROM memories_artifacts ma
JOIN artifacts a ON a.id = ma.artifact_id
JOIN annotations an ON an.artifact_id = a.id
WHERE ma.memory_id::text = ${memory:sqlstring}
  AND (${artifact:sqlstring} = 'all' OR a.id::text = ${artifact:sqlstring})
ORDER BY an.created_at DESC
LIMIT 1000
